children: Structure Therapeutics reported positive topline SAD results for ACCG-2671 and durable 72-week weight-loss results for aleniglipron.
ACCG-2671 SAD: showed ~6-day terminal half-life, rapid Tmax (1–1.5 hrs) and dose-proportional exposure supporting daily or weekly dosing.
ACCG-2671 safety: no serious adverse events or drug-induced liver injury; GI events emerged at ≥5 mg informing lower start and titration.
ACCG-2671 early PD: single 10 mg dose associated with mean 3.3% weight loss at Day 24 and ~60% reduction in CTX-1 at Day 2.
MAD trial initiated for ACCG-2671 in participants with obesity; topline MAD data expected in 1H 2027.
Aleniglipron ACCESS OLE: up to 16.2% mean weight loss at 72 weeks (120→180 mg cohort), >1/3 in top cohorts achieved ≥20% loss, <5% discontinuations for TEAEs.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Structure Therapeutics reports positive ACCG-2671 SAD data and aleniglipron 72-week ACCESS OLE results
